sources.title: Metabolic cost and efficiency in two forms of squatting exercise in children and adults
Comparison of kinetic variables and muscle activity during a squat vs. a box squat

why.headline: Practise a controlled squat with a pause.
why.unavailable: No reviewed goalkeeper-specific benefit is available for this variation.

expect.unavailable: No reviewed estimate of this variation's training effect is available.

muscles.unavailable: No reviewed muscle map is available for this variation.

claims.text: A study compared two squat styles in children and adults. One paused at the lowest position. It measured oxygen use and efficiency, not this pause above a box.
A study of eight resistance-trained adults compared loaded squats and box squats. It measured force and muscle activity, not this youth variation.

limits.text: Neither study tested this exact pause in young goalkeepers.
